newsitem.title: JAPAN: Orix plans to invest in new domestic carrier - paper.
newsitem.headline: Orix plans to invest in new domestic carrier - paper.

text.p: Orix Corp plans to invest in a new airline that H.I.S. Co Ltd, a Tokyo-based discount airline ticket agency, hopes to establish, a Japanese economic daily said at the weekend.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Saturday that a former chairman of Yamato Transport Co Ltd, Masao Ogura, also planned to invest in the new carrier and that Toyota Motor Corp was considering taking part in the project.
Orix, a leasing company, and Ogura were expected to invest up to 10 million yen each, the paper said. Orix might also send some officials to help with the new airline's management, the paper said.
Ogura and officials from Orix and Toyota were not immediately available for comment.
Earlier this month, H.I.S. announced plans to start regular domestic flights within two years.
It would be the first time in 43 years that a new company was set up to offer nationwide flights. The new company hopes to offer Haneda-Sapporo flights at half the current price.
